en: <CLT=cltMIND>It looks like I have some free time.

<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>I shouldn't waste time worrying...
I should get some rest.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
